title: Poetry and Feeling Words
description: Explore lines and stanzas, rhyming words, sensory language, feelings in poems, and writing a short poem.
learningFocus: Identify words and phrases in poems that suggest feelings or appeal to the senses (RL.1.4), while reading grade-appropriate poetry with support (RL.1.10).
adultGuidance: Poems are written in lines, and a poem can have sentences too. Help your child read the poem aloud and listen for words that rhyme. Point to words that tell what the child sees, hears, feels, or smells. Ask how the poem feels, and which words tell you. Then let your child write a poem about the picture.
